title: Hanasato Minori — Game Face At The Meeting!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, the proposals for these streams look fine. Next, let's start talking about that show we're going to be regulars on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound so excited, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I mean, we get to appear as regulars!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to do my best so that we can leave the staff we work with feeling glad that they asked MORE MORE JUMP! to be part of this show!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're in a tough spot right now, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka, is that true...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We stopped receiving offers because of ReLight...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That rumor about Mr. Hiiragi is one thing, and so is the fact that we don't have the backing of a big agency...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the real problem we're facing right now is that we lack the ability to fight back.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Right...
We're in a pretty tough pickle.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In order to get through this, we'll need to give each work opportunity we receive the utmost care.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and I'm not worried. I know we'll find a way out of this jam.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: On that note, let's start talking about the segment MORE MORE JUMP! will be running.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our viewers are gonna write to us about their problems, right?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Helping others is exactly what we did with Mr. Nakano during “The Town Revitalization Team!”

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes, but minus helping a town get back on its feet. You'll be dealing with a wide variety of problems.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: On top of there being no telling what people are going to ask, we still don't know how you're actually going to be helping each sender.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... Right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, this is a little off-topic, but remember the show we did at that elementary school?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, because it was closing down.
You're talking about our graduation show, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I've been hoping that we might get to do something like that on this show!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
It certainly seems appropriate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's get down to business.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As it so happens, I got a narrowed-down list of possible problems for us to solve from Mr. Nakano.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, people have already written in?! But he said he'd give us more details at a later date!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: The show apparently put out a survey on social media asking, “If you were to ask MORE MORE JUMP! for advice, then what would it be about?”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see.
What kinds of questions do you think they sent?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You gotta tell us, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, relax.
I've printed copies for everyone, so lemme pass them out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, this person said, “I always get so nervous whenever I take a test at school.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Not being able to achieve the results you want because of nerves after studying really hard is pretty demoralizing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and every single test is crucial if you have entrance exams coming up.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This person caught my eye. “I got into a big argument with my friend and don't know how we're going to make up.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that one stood out to me as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because it's going to become very difficult for them to mend their friendship by themselves if too much time passes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I really wanna help them somehow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew... Th-That's all of them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We managed to whittle the list of questions Mr. Nakano sent us down to just a few.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Thank you for all your hard work!
Here, I made some tea. Enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That was really hard, but I'm glad we have our list of candidates now!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Umm...
I was wondering what's gonna happen to these other questions.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ideally, they'll be saved for later episodes...
But we realistically won't be able to help everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I had a feeling...
Even though they went to the trouble of writing to us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what if we replied to them during one of our streams?! Would that be possible?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... We'd have to ask Mr. Nakano about that. Why don't we float it out there when we send him our reply?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you mean it?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree with what you said about them taking the time to write to us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I'd like to help as many of them as we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're still in the middle of hammering out the details for this segment, so I'm sure Mr. Nakano would welcome this sort of suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, let's take this opportunity to come up with even more ideas!
